div.div: • Workload accounts are separated by legal entity, not by region: each has its own EKS cluster in P and in R.

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 298px; height: 1px; padding-top: 633px; margin-left: 1332px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #232F3E;
display: inline-block; font-size: 11px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#232F3E, #bdc7d4); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div: • No default cross-entity routes, shared payment databases or shared Kong instances.

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 298px; height: 1px; padding-top: 729px; margin-left: 1332px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #232F3E;
display: inline-block; font-size: 11px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#232F3E, #bdc7d4); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div: • Recovery accounts hold immutable backups and clean-room restores; live Aurora Global Database members stay in the workload account.

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 298px; height: 1px; padding-top: 824px; margin-left: 1332px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #232F3E;
display: inline-block; font-size: 11px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#232F3E, #bdc7d4); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div: • Platform owns self-hosted Kong; application teams consume governed routes. No Amazon API Gateway or Konnect.

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 298px; height: 1px; padding-top: 920px; margin-left: 1332px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #232F3E;
display: inline-block; font-size: 11px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#232F3E, #bdc7d4); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div: • Logs, backups, artifacts and telemetry need explicit residency, KMS and retention controls; cross-border approval (C05) is not a blanket export permission.

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 298px; height: 1px; padding-top: 1023px; margin-left: 1332px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #232F3E;
display: inline-block; font-size: 11px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#232F3E, #bdc7d4); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div: • Recovery endpoints exist, but writers and submitters are never active in both regions; traffic switching cannot enforce this.
